        x=np.sin(ph)+fil*np.sin(2*ph-.3)+(.12+.28*np.exp(-t/.052))*np.sin(3*ph+.8)
        x=np.tanh(1.25*x)
        env=(1-np.exp(-t/.0025))*(.65*np.exp(-t/.29)+.35*np.exp(-t/.58))*np.clip((.79-t)/.13,0,1)

    detune=np.sin(p*1.003+0.7)
    x=(.72*np.sin(p)*np.exp(-t/0.38)+.24*detune*np.exp(-t/.29)
       +.33*np.sin(2*p+.8)*np.exp(-t/.135)+.20*np.sin(3*p+.25)*np.exp(-t/.09)
       +.10*np.sin(5*p)*np.exp(-t/.036))

    return norm(x,.85),17

    x=(np.sin(phi)+.28*np.sin(2*p+1.1)+.18*np.sin(4*p+.1))
    env=(1-np.exp(-t/.0015))*np.exp(-t/.20)*np.clip((.82-t)/.12,0,1)

def pad():
    fs=22318;t=np.arange(int(2.15*fs))/fs;p=phasewaves(t)
    # two gently detuned oscillators, their beating embedded in PCM
    x=(.46*np.sin(p) + .24*np.sin(p*1.004+1.0) + .20*np.sin(p*.996-0.8)
       +.16*np.sin(2*p+.7) + .075*np.sin(3*p+.1))
    breathe=(.88+.12*np.sin(2*np.pi*.63*t+1.3))
    env=(1-np.exp(-t/.095))*(.73+.27*np.exp(-t/.4))

def lead():
    fs=33452;t=np.arange(int(3.02*fs))/fs;p=phasewaves(t)
    # saturated pulse + organ core, initial airy overtone, gentle wobble in tail
    width=.37+.010*np.sin(2*np.pi*3.6*t)
    # Fourier pulse with alternating phase yields compact chiptune timbre
    harmonic=np.zeros_like(t)
    for k in range(1,12):
        harmonic+=2*np.sin(np.pi*k*width)/(np.pi*k)*np.cos(k*p-np.pi*k*width)*np.exp(-.017*k*k)
    x=.68*harmonic + .37*np.sin(p) +.13*np.sin(2*p+.35)
    x=np.tanh(x*1.40)
    e=(1-np.exp(-t/.012))*(.36+.64*np.exp(-t/.78)) * np.clip((3.02-t)/.36,0,1)
    # at E5, stored 3 seconds translates to 0.95 seconds
    return norm(x*e,.88),24

      +.29*np.sin(2*p+.2)*np.exp(-t/.44)

      +.12*np.sin(6.12*p+.1)*np.exp(-t/.14)
      +.07*np.sin(9.28*p)*np.exp(-t/.065))
    x*=(1-np.exp(-t/.002))*np.clip((2.2-t)/.32,0,1)

def riser():
    fs=22318;t=np.arange(int(.81*fs))/fs
    white=rng.normal(size=len(t));

    sm=np.convolve(white,np.ones(40)/40,'same')

    e=(1-np.exp(-t/.018))*np.clip((.81-t)/.17,0,1)
    return norm(x*e,.84),17

def pcm_bytes(x):
    w=np.rint(np.clip(x,-1,1)*32766).astype(np.int32)
    return np.diff(w,prepend=0).astype('<i2').tobytes(),len(w)*2

def instrument_block(name,x,relative,vol,pan):
    hdr=bytearray(263)
    struct.pack_into('<I',hdr,0,263)
    hdr[4:26]=name.encode('ascii','replace')[:22].ljust(22,b'\x00')
    struct.pack_into('<H',hdr,27,1)
    struct.pack_into('<I',hdr,29,40)
    # no instrument envelope: PCM dynamics are authored into the sound itself.
    packed,nbytes=pcm_bytes(x)
    samplehdr=struct.pack('<IIIBbBBbB',nbytes,0,0,vol,0,16,pan,relative,0)
    samplehdr+=name.encode('ascii','replace')[:22].ljust(22,b'\x00')
    assert len(samplehdr)==40
    return bytes(hdr)+samplehdr+packed

def packed_event(ev):
    n,i,v,f,fp=ev

    mask=0x80
    for j,x in enumerate(values):
